readingMode: All 87 physical pages read in full, including introduction, every paragraph/numbered measure, two graphical indexes, all 21 chapter dividers, blank page and back cover. All 28 minimal-native-text pages visually inspected. No appendix/endnote.
territorialScope: National Frente Obrero political programme published as NUESTRO PROGRAMA on its archived July 12 2023 general-election campaign homepage. Applies as the movement programme used during this campaign to reconciled Frente Obrero Congress ballots. Page 7 explicitly says it is not an electoral programme; preserve that characterisation and never present political aspirations as independently guaranteed election outcomes.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Original cover visually read: Documentos políticos, Una España para los trabajadores, Frente Obrero logo. No 23J election date appears on the cover.
Original full-page demonstration photograph visually inspected; party flags/banner, no policy paragraph.
Original graphical index read in full: introduction and chapters 1–15, with page locators from labour through pensions.
Original graphical index continuation read in full: chapters 16–21 on migration, territorial structure, justice, police, army and prisons. No appendix listed.
Original introduction divider visually read: La España que debemos ser; repeated document title.

Read the complete introduction narrative on labour, party-system critique, sovereignty, economic problems and criticism of gender-related politics. Polemical and causal claims are attributed to the source.

Read the full continuation and explicit qualification: this is a revolutionary movement's political programme, not an electoral programme, aiming at a constituent process and Popular Federal Republic. July archival presence alone does not resolve campaign adoption.

Read the whole electoral-participation explanation: elections used for agitation, awareness and organising rather than joining representative-system operation. No hidden policy text beyond the paragraph.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Los trabajadores primero; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read entire labour chapter introduction: wages, unemployment, employer/union criticism, industrial decline and class movement. No invented wage euro amount.

Read numbered labour measures 1–6: raise minimum/general wages with living cost, safety enforcement, political/solidarity strike rights, compulsory representation in workplaces with at least ten employees, irregular-worker exploitation and progressive self-employed charges; clause 6 continues.

Read clause 6 continuation and measures 7–12: no self-employed charge below minimum wage, sickness waiver/retirement, false self-employment, labour-reform repeal, restrictions on temporary and seasonal permanent contracts, temporary agency ban, overtime rules, benefits and disability employment.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Soberanía nacional; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read full sovereignty introduction and first proposal: immediate EU exit. Source claims on historical causes, tourism and agricultural productivity remain attributed.
Read all remaining sovereignty proposals: immediate NATO exit, foreign military-base removal/Gibraltar control and Sahrawi self-determination. Treat each policy separately.

Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Reindustrialización y nacionalización de los sectores estratégicos; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read whole reindustrialisation/nationalisation narrative, strategic-sector privatisation critique and environmental qualification 'en la medida de lo posible'. Do not certify causal assertions.
Read all four concrete proposals: strategic-sector nationalisation, industrial priorities, rural/high-quality tourism and research/development investment. Do not infer ownership of every small shop.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Soberanía energética; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read complete energy introduction, claimed EU constraints, import percentage, utility criticism and energy planning argument; continues next page. No independent fact certification.

Read nuclear rationale and energy measures 1–5: end the named transition policy, immediate bill/fuel regulation, utility/revolving-door controls, prevent productive plant closures and expand/modernise nuclear plants plus domestic uranium exploitation.
Read measures 6–7 fully: renewables complement nuclear, technology research and smart/digital electricity-network modernisation. Nuclear support does not imply rejecting renewable generation.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Fiscalidad; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read fiscal narrative and first income-tax proposal for low-resource workers, continued next page. No universal flat tax or exact new rate stated.

Read income-tax continuation and proposals 2–8: higher upper rates, lower essentials VAT, higher large-business corporate/wealth taxes, central succession tax with low-income exemption, Church fiscal advantages removed, technology tax, fraud inspection and hardship debt repayment.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Educación; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read whole education introduction, costs/infrastructure/methodology critique and ideological assertions. Negative scientific characterisations are the source's claims.

Read complete continuation and education measures 1–6: free education/enrolment/materials at all levels, scholarships, free school meals, facilities, reduced private/concerted-school subsidies and public-staff conditions/training.

Read measures 7–12: paid practical placements, brain-drain prevention, private-company removal from public education governing bodies, Castilian or mother-tongue study, religion limited to historical/scientific treatment and special-needs education. Restrictions must not be conflated with abolishing every private school.
Read full final education measure: promote sport through public schools; no further paragraph.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Cultura; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read entire culture introduction: class access, national culture, internet-platform influence and transformative art. Critiques are attributed ideological statements.
Read complete continuation on popular cultural production, sport and party critique, then first cultural-production measure.

Read culture measures 2–8: school programmes, free museums/heritage/libraries/film archives, rural/worker-area facilities, lower cultural-product taxes, move toward ending gambling/alcohol/pornography/prostitution advertising, sport facilities and career transition.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Juventud; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.
Read the full youth introduction on employment, living conditions, consumption and civic involvement. Do not repeat polemical conclusions as neutral help.

Read youth measures 1–8: work placements, youth housing/aid, unified transport card under 26, associations, digital resources, drug-trafficking enforcement, public addiction care and alcohol/gambling advertising ban.
Read youth measures 9–10 fully: sexual education and free contraceptive products throughout pharmacies. No age ceiling or named list of products specified.
Entire original graphical chapter divider visually read: Mujer e igualdad real; repeated document title and chapter number, no additional policy paragraph.

Read whole women/equality introduction: sex/gender argument, prostitution abolition qualified by socialist material conditions and opposition to surrogacy. Further proposals follow; do not infer clauses not yet read.

Read the complete equality continuation: opposition to gender language/quotas and positive discrimination, natality/work compatibility and claims about innocence and the Equality Ministry. Polemical causal claims remain attributed.

Read all introductory continuation and measures 1–5: natality support, anti-trafficking plans, surrogacy prohibition, repeal of the Trans Law, and partial or total repeal of positive-discrimination laws. Whole-law repeal does not supply a stance on every isolated provision.
Read measures 6–7 in full: abolish Equality Ministry, transfer its whole budget to social uses, and abolish quotas. No hidden additional policy text.
Original graphical chapter 10 divider read: Natalidad y familia; repeated document title, no extra policy.

Original graphical chapter 11 divider read: Mundo rural; repeated title, no extra policy.

Read the complete rural introduction on EU agricultural policy, productive land, small farms, large owners and worker exploitation. Production/cause claims are attributed rather than independently confirmed.
Read entire continuation on imported food, livestock, fisheries, hunting/ecosystem control and rural decline. Hunting is not banned in this chapter.

Read concrete rural measures 1–7: break restrictive EU policy/treaties, expropriate unused large-owner land for farmers/cooperatives, cooperatives, modernisation, worker safety, Spanish-water fishing claims and sustainable fisheries/aquaculture.

Read measures 8–14: water plans and maintenance, biodiversity, State hunting/wildlife competence with local hunters, rural jobs/services and historical heritage. Do not infer unrestricted hunting or every inter-basin transfer.
Original graphical chapter 12 divider read: Libertades básicas; no further policy.

Original graphical chapter 13 divider read: Sanidad; no extra policy.

Read health measures 1–4 with every subparagraph: centralise/unify system, stop privatisation/outsourcing, increase investment/primary care/resources/waiting-list reduction, free dental/physio/eye treatment and mental-health staff.

Read measures 5–8: prevention, all health-worker conditions including outsourced cleaning, cheaper prescription drugs tending to free in special need, national pharmaceutical industry and public elderly care-home places. Medication promise is qualified rather than free for everyone immediately.
Original graphical chapter 14 divider read: Vivienda; no extra policy.

Read full continuation distinguishing vulnerable-family occupation and criminal occupation mafias, then anti-speculation and broad social-housing stock measures. State supervision discussed, operational rent measure follows.

Read housing measures 3–10: restore empty homes, State supervision of rent prices, suspend working-family evictions until housing alternative, utilities, mortgage second chances/dation, anti-criminal-occupation efforts, tourist-flat/gentrification measures and homeless employment reintegration. Original graphical chapter 15 divider read: Pensiones; no extra policy.

Read timing qualification and five measures: raise minimum/noncontributory pensions, average best contribution years, reverse retirement-age rise with occupation-related retirement age, activity/employment and retired social involvement. No exact fixed age or number of calculation years.
Original graphical chapter 16 divider read: Inmigración; no extra policy.

Read full continuation on trafficking, party criticism, existing migrants' integration and natality. Social outcome assertions are source claims, not public quiz help.

Read full continuation asserting cultural rather than racial nation, planned integration and opposition to open-border strategies. Theoretical assertions do not replace concrete eligibility conditions.

Preserve chronology and do not claim all irregular residents expelled.
Read measures 7–9 fully: sanction organisations evading law, Spanish-culture integration respecting differences and equal migrant/native work conditions with employer supervision.

Read municipal-fusion/administrative narrative and four concrete measures: equal regional powers/fiscal regime, central health/education, remove duplicate roles and promote municipal mergers. No population threshold or compulsory all-town merger stated.
Original graphical chapter 18 divider read: Justicia; no extra policy.

Original graphical chapter 19 divider read: Fuerzas y cuerpos de seguridad del Estado; no extra policy.

Original graphical chapter 20 divider read: Ejército; no extra policy.

Entire original page visually inspected: blank white page, no omitted policy.

uncertainties: All numeric positions remain null pending full-corpus cross-reference, directly authored question rubrics, independently reopened source context and calibration.

Primary original and July 12 archived PDF bytes are identical. The same-day archived campaign homepage links those bytes as NUESTRO PROGRAMA; campaign adoption context is now established. Page 7 still explicitly calls it a political rather than electoral programme.

Native text has recurring spacing artefacts. All 28 minimal-native-text pages, including both indexes, chapter dividers, blank page and back cover, were visually read. Quotes preserve native spacing; source display needs original-page access where extraction is awkward.
Rent-price supervision does not specify the same operational conditions as the 2023 Housing Act or a universal fixed-price cap.

Regularisation is conditional for stable long-term residents who arrived before control measures; later irregular entrants excluded. Never collapse this into unconditional support or opposition for every current irregular migrant.
Minimum/noncontributory pension rises have no exact euros; reverse retirement-age rise has no fixed age; birth leaves prolonged with no exact weeks; youth transport card is not explicitly free.
Whole-law repeal of the Trans Law and positive-discrimination laws does not prove a stance on every independent question about each provision.
Polemical, historical, legal, statistical and causal assertions remain attributed statements. They do not provide independently certified facts or neutral explanatory forecasts.
authorship: Direct complete programme reading and authored English analysis retaining exact literal Spanish excerpts. Deterministic source/hash/quote/schema checks only; no generated questions or numeric positions.
